chunks: "Whoever counts tomorrow as part of his lifespan has indeed kept bad company with death."

key_terms.أَسَاءَ: acted badly or failed in proper conduct
key_terms.غَدًا: tomorrow; the assumed future time a person expects to reach

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about expecting to live until tomorrow?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches constant awareness of death and warns against assuming one is guaranteed another day of life. It encourages a person to live with urgency, humility, and readiness for the end.
